functions.name: UpdateRenderDisplayState
functions.summary: Per-frame render-state dispatcher for a multi-slot graphics display. Computes a packed RGB blend value from a2+380/384/388 via CRTFtol, writes it to a2+340 and, when it changes, pushes it to the context through vtable+200 (command 60). Then iterates 4 display slots (switch via jpt_55527D), picking per-slot base/count from a2+436..464 and calling ModeStateSetterThroughVtable; for each slot it walks the element groups, runs rich (v14[39]&0x400) and plain element paths that dispatch sprite draw commands through context vtable+340/+284/+200, update camera/sound state (TwoFieldSetterCall, CameraProjectionUpdate, SoundInstanceUpdate), log session changes (LogSessionEvent) when the element ID differs from this+0x13CC, and chain-init display slots. Finishes with a vehicle sync block when the a2+236 bitmask is clean and a2+348 list is non-empty, dispatching command 47 or restoring two fields on a3, and returns the camera update result.

functions.name: HighResolutionTimerInit
functions.summary: Initializes a high-resolution timer structure (legacy ABI name Unidentified_Logic_High_Res_Timer_Setup). Selects a backend by the mode argument a2: mode 1 reads QueryPerformanceFrequency/QueryPerformanceCounter and stores the counter low/high parts and the frequency low part; mode 2 snapshots an RDTSC timestamp through RDTSCTimestampRead and stores 1000000 * v11 as the base. Both paths then finalize the struct: copy the last timestamp (0x18/0x1C) to a previous pair (0x20/0x24), zero accumulator fields (0x10/0x14, 0x28/0x2C, 0x4/0x5 pairs via 0x10/0x14), store the mode selector at offset 0x48, and compute the conversion factor 2^32 / base at the double at offset 0x8. Always returns 0. Called from engine init, audio-system, and other setup paths.

QPC path: if QueryPerformanceFrequency(&Frequency) succeeds, query QueryPerformanceCounter(&PerformanceCount).
QPC path: store the query results - last-query timestamp low part at offset 0x18 and high part at offset 0x1C, and the frequency low part as the base at offset 0x0.
RDTSC path: StructZeroInitConstructor_f080(v10), GlobalDataCopy(v10), RDTSCTimestampRead((char *)this + 28, this + 3) snapshots the timestamp, and EmptyStub_7470(v10) releases the scratch.
RDTSC path: store 1000000 * v11 as the base at offset 0x0.
Finalization: copy the stored last-query low part from offset 0x18 into the previous low part at offset 0x20, and keep the high part v7 from offset 0x1C.

Finalization: store the mode selector a2 at offset 0x48; zero the accumulators at offsets 0x10 and 0x14 (dword index pairs 4/5) and offsets 0x28 and 0x2C (indices 10/11); store v7 as the previous high part at offset 0x24.
Compute the tick-to-time conversion factor as the double at offset 0x8: 4294967296.0 divided by the (double) unsigned base value read from offset 0x0.
Return 0 in all paths.

functions.name: SceneNode

Allocates and constructs a 572-byte scene graph node, attaches it to a parent (a3), then consumes a token stream (a4) one line at a time, matching keyword strings against the node's mesh/animation/LOD/collision/shadow/render/visibility properties and setting bit flags and float/view fields. On stream end it links the node into the scene graph (doubly-linked or actor-list append) and optionally applies orientation/view data; on parse failure it frees the node.
